paragraphs: Rami bar Rav Yod, Taanit 22b; and so it should read in Shabbat 32b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: יוד is retained as Yod without adopting the earlier speculative Yudai identification. Rav is written in full in both units.

וכן צ״ל is Hyman’s correction instruction, “and so it should read,” applying Rami bar Rav Yod to Shabbat 32b. This is his proposed emendation, not a verified replacement. Taanit 22b and Shabbat 32b follow the colon convention; no named edition is independently checked.
